resources.string: Shows chat over landscape video instead of shrinking it. Example: enable here or in the player menu, drag the handle to move and drag the size button to resize. Portrait, mini-player and PiP keep their normal layout. Opening chat input docks chat again.
Darkens the chat background without fading text or emotes. Example: 0 is transparent; 70 makes busy video easier to read through. Applies when chat is next shown.

Adds bold text and a dark shadow while floating. Example: keep messages readable over bright gameplay. The A button in the chat window toggles this immediately; sidebar styling is restored when chat docks.
Move chat: drag, or tap for position actions
Resize chat: drag, or tap to switch size
High-contrast text is on. Tap to turn off
High-contrast text is off. Tap to turn on
